proof_body:
by
  intro f g f' g' c R hR hf' hg' hf hg
  have hfc : ContinuousOn f (Metric.sphere c R) := fun z hz => (hf z hz).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hgc : ContinuousOn g (Metric.sphere c R) := fun z hz => (hg z hz).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have i1 : CircleIntegrable (fun z => f z * g' z) c R := (hfc.mul hg').circleIntegrable hR
  have i2 : CircleIntegrable (fun z => f' z * g z) c R := (hf'.mul hgc).circleIntegrable hR
  have h0 : (∮ z in C(c, R), (f' z * g z + f z * g' z)) = 0 := by
    apply circleIntegral.integral_eq_zero_of_hasDerivWithinAt' (f := fun z => f z * g z)
    intro z hz
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hR] at hz
    exact ((hf z hz).mul (hg z hz)).hasDerivWithinAt
  rw [circleIntegral.integral_add i2 i1] at h0
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h0
target_source: ∀ (f g f' g' : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ), 0 ≤ R → ContinuousOn f' (Metric.sphere c R) → ContinuousOn g' (Metric.sphere c R) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c R, HasDerivAt f (f' z) z) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c R, HasDerivAt g (g' z) z) → (∮ z in C(c, R), f z * g' z) = -∮ z in C(c, R), f' z * g z
